protocol.comparison: R5 and R6 run on the same frozen held-out cases
protocol.execution_policy: The held-out split is executed once. No checker, corpus, reference or criterion may be changed after execution begins. Development probes are not held-out evidence.

corpus_revision_before_execution.revision: R6-E12 was replaced before held-out execution. The original negation-reversal case was removed because invented uncertainty was a required held-out category and was absent. Negation reversal remains represented in R6-E04.

hard_gates.name: No material false acceptance
hard_gates.criterion: Zero held-out corruption cases receive policy USE_TRANSFORMATION. Any single material false acceptance blocks adoption.

hard_gates.name: Corruption detection
hard_gates.criterion: At least 10 of the 12 held-out corruption cases are detected with the expected finding type and distinction, a matching source span, and a matching transformation span when the reference specifies one.

hard_gates.name: False-rejection non-regression
hard_gates.criterion: R6 false rejections on the eight held-out faithful cases are no worse than R5 false rejections on the same eight cases. A false rejection is policy PRESERVE_SOURCE on a faithful case.

hard_gates.name: Uncertainty separation
hard_gates.criterion: For R6-E21 through R6-E24, UNRESOLVED is present and no UNSUPPORTED_UNCERTAINTY finding is present. For R6-E12, UNSUPPORTED_UNCERTAINTY is present and no UNRESOLVED finding is present. No held-out case contains both UNRESOLVED and UNSUPPORTED_UNCERTAINTY as primary findings.
hard_gates.threshold: 4/4 justified and 1/1 invented clean; zero dual-primary cases

hard_gates.name: No fabricated equivalence
hard_gates.criterion: Every USE_TRANSFORMATION decision has positive preservation evidence (at least one PRESERVED_CANDIDATE finding) and no MATERIAL, UNRESOLVED or NOT_ASSESSED finding. Silence is never treated as equivalence. Any case with no findings is reported as NOT_ASSESSED and cannot receive USE_TRANSFORMATION.

secondary_targets.name: Faithful acceptance
secondary_targets.target: At least 7 of 8 held-out faithful cases receive USE_TRANSFORMATION; zero false rejections is the preferred result.

secondary_targets.name: Ambiguity routing
secondary_targets.target: 4 of 4 held-out ambiguity cases receive REQUEST_CLARIFICATION.

secondary_targets.name: Policy accuracy
secondary_targets.target: At least 22 of 24 held-out cases receive the reference policy.

secondary_targets.name: Evidence grounding
secondary_targets.target: All matched corruption findings have a source span. Transformation grounding is reported separately, including expected findings that specify no transformation quote.

required_reporting: Per-case outcomes, not only aggregate accuracy.
Corruption detection, corruption misses and material false acceptances.
Counts of NOT_ASSESSED and UNRESOLVED, not silently excluded.
Constraint comparisons and epistemic judgments for each case.
R5 and R6 measured on the same frozen cases, with paired per-case changes.
Implementation complexity and the number of new rule patterns.
Explicit architectural decision: CONTINUE, REVISE_ARCHITECTURE or STOP_THIS_APPROACH.

decision_rule.continue: All hard gates pass, R6 shows a credible paired improvement over R5, and the fixes generalise through constraint and epistemic rules rather than case-specific fixtures. CONTINUE still requires independent adjudication before any integration.
decision_rule.revise_architecture: At least one hard gate fails, or all hard gates pass but R6 remains dependent on a growing set of case-specific lexical rules, or the improvement is narrow relative to the added complexity. Local rules may remain useful, but they are not reliable as the main semantic comparison mechanism.
decision_rule.stop_this_approach: Multiple hard gates fail, especially a material false acceptance combined with detection below 10/12 or no measurable improvement over R5, or the evidence shows the rule-based design cannot separate material change from faithful paraphrase without unbounded case-specific rules.
decision_rule.not_automatic: CONTINUE is not the default. The decision must cite the measured gates and the paired R5 comparison.

notes: The author-constructed references are provisional and are not independent human adjudication.
Passing these gates is experimental qualification, not proof of production safety.
No hosted model is used. No Studio communication integration, manuscript change, commit or push is permitted.
Historical R1-R5 artifacts and hashes remain frozen and must not be edited.
